title: Tyla Is Hitting the Road to Support New Album ‘A*Pop’: Here Are the Tour Dates
summary: She will bring her new era to fans across Europe, North America and Africa beginning this fall.
contentText:
Tyla isn’t wasting any time bringing A*Pop to the stage.

Just days after releasing her awaited sophomore album, the two-time Grammy winner announced on Monday (July 27) that she’ll be kicking off her A*Pop World Tour this fall. Among other successes, this will be her first time headlining across countries including Europe, North America, and even her homeland in Africa.

The 34-date run will begin on Oct. 12 in Paris before making its way through cities including Amsterdam, London, Brussels and Stockholm. She will embark on her North American dates starting on Nov. 12 in Wheatland, Calif., before stopping in Vancouver, B.C.; Chicago; Boston; New York City; San Diego and Las Vegas. The tour will wrap with performances in Africa, including dates in Lagos, Nigeria; and Cape Town and Johannesburg in South Africa through early 2027.

The tour announcement arrives just as Tyla continues building on the impelling force of her breakout achievements. Her Grammy-winning smash “Water” reached No. 7 on the Billboard Hot 100, while her 2024 self-titled debut peaked at No. 24 on the Billboard 200 . She was also honored with the Impact Award at the Billboard’s 2025 Women in Music event, where she was recognized for her influence in bringing African music and amapiano to listeners worldwide.

Tickets for the A*Pop World Tour will be available starting with an artist presale beginning on Wednesday, July 29. General on sale begins Friday, July 31. More information can be found on Tyla’s website .
